name: Lyo.Web.Automation.Postgres
tagline: PostgreSQL store for automation plans and the plan grid query.
description: Stores each plan as a row in `automation.automation_plans`: id, unique name, jsonb document, step count, and updated time. `AddAutomationPlansPostgres` replaces `IAutomationPlanStore`. `BuildAutomationPlanRecords` maps query and get on `Automation/Plans` when the host has the context.
features: Name routes and `GET /Automation/Plan/id/{id}` read the same rows.
The grid route is `Automation/Plans` with QueryProject.
